I know it is at a fraction of when you bought that stock but after the recent fall, do you think they will show the same kind of leadership as they did seven to eight months back? Sudip Bandyopadhyay: Well, I do not think they will show the kind of leadership which we did see them demonstrating about seven-eight months back. I think that was a bit over the top and a bit irrational. The valuation was definitely out of sync with the fundamentals. Things have cooled down quite a bit, but even then they are not cheap even today. But I do like BEL, Bharat Electronics, quite a bit and I have been recommending a buy there. BEL is in defence electronics and it caters to Air Force, Army, Navy – all the three segments. They have gone into exports as well. It is a very well-managed company, strong balance sheet, and they are now moving out of defence electronics and into major other areas like metro travel, so the opportunity for this company to continue to perform and outperform is significant.
